stps.note: Compliance is mapped from the Gujarat MPR Apr 2021 single "Compliance / Non Compliance" flag: "Non Compliance" means the plant fails the consent standards (BOD 20 mg/l, i.e. the MoEFCC 2017 norm), so it fails both NGT and MoEFCC. "Compliance" means it meets the consent standard, so it meets MoEFCC; NGT compliance (BOD 10 mg/l) cannot be inferred from a consent flag and is left null. The Mar 2021 flags are contradicted by the Gujarat High Court / GPCB findings of 2024 (9 of 14 Ahmedabad STPs not meeting standards); the MPR vintage is stated on every plant.

water_quality.note: Series years are not like-for-like: 2018 = CPCB polluted-stretch maxima as reproduced by CSE; 2020 = single Apr 2020 samples (COVID lockdown month) from the Gujarat MPR; 2023 = GPCB Annual Report 2022-23 yearly averages. Trends are indicative only. Faecal coliform was measured only in Apr 2020. No station has a continuous annual series.
